mediaWork.title: 3 ½ Minutes, 10 Bullets
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Examines the 2012 shooting death of 17-year-old Jordan Davis by Michael Dunn, exploring the trial, "Stand Your Ground" law, and racial bias.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: On Black Friday 2012, four boys in a red SUV rolled into a gas station after a day at the mall. A man with his fiancé, Michael Dunn, pulled up beside them. An altercation over loud music escalated into a tragedy.
